header: From first SDK call to your first funnel report
description: Most teams have a working funnel on the day they sign up. There is no data model to design first: send events with the names you already use in product reviews, and the platform sorts out the rest.

items.title: Send one event
items.description: Drop in the JavaScript or mobile SDK, call track once, and watch it arrive in the live stream within 12 seconds.

items.title: Name what matters
items.description: Mark the four or five events that make up a signup or a checkout. Nothing else needs labelling before you can query.

items.title: Build the funnel
items.description: Pick the steps in order, set the conversion window, read the drop-off. Median build time in new workspaces is under 5 minutes.
